title: fix(plugin-list): a list's column header opens a menu and keeps a multi-level sort; a sort chip opens the sort panel
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu4VYaRHnpxtm9VEZHYFJeKJ)_

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgTXY4rajwZcQmpLxS2

Fixes #35876

Clause-②: yes (widening) — new members on the `@object-ui/components` entry: `GridHeaderMenuProvider` and `useGridHeaderMenu`; a new optional `headerMenu` runtime prop on `ObjectGrid` (`@object-ui/plugin-grid`); a new `sortBuilder.reorder` key in every `@object-ui/i18n` locale; nothing removed or renamed
Metadata-protocol: none

Flow: dev-thread rule (maintainer 2026-11-20 09:22:50Z 「所有 p1 都按照新规则执行」): the card thread builds itself; L1 and the isolated L2 run in parallel at hand-back (epic #35547 child, run under that rule by the seat's claim 7045047594).

## 维护者速读

- 列表页（所有用列表组件画出的表格）：点列头不再直接排序，而是弹出菜单「升序排列 / 降序排列 / 隐藏列」；已有两级以上排序时，选中的列排到第一级，其余各级顺延，不再被清掉；只有一级或没有排序时直接换成这一列。点排序标签改为打开排序面板，不再直接反转方向；面板里每级多了拖动手柄，拖动或用上下键调先后。
- 属于专题「列表页重做」，修的是「点一下列头，辛苦设好的多级排序全没了，而且已经存成个人设置」和「标签看起来能点开，点了却直接把方向反了」这两个问题。
- 风险：其他地方的表格（相关列表、仪表盘表格等）保持点列头直接排序，不受影响；列表页的使用者要多点一次才能排序。出问题可直接撤回本 PR，不涉及数据和保存方式。
- 无。

## What changes

**The list page's column header opens a menu** (`@object-ui/components` data-table, `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, `@object-ui/plugin-list`). Only a table under the new `GridHeaderMenuProvider` changes; `ObjectGrid` mounts it when its host passes `headerMenu`, and `ListView` passes it on the object-grid it draws (beside `cellSelection`, the same reach as #35683's ruling 7035276698, as the seat routed). Every other table keeps click-to-sort.

- A click on a header opens the column menu below it: Sort ascending, Sort descending, Hide column. The header itself never changes the sort; a second click on the same header shuts its menu.
- Keyboard: every header takes focus (`tabIndex 0`, `aria-haspopup="menu"`, `aria-expanded`); Enter, Space or ArrowDown opens the menu with its first entry focused; the arrows move, Enter chooses, Esc shuts it without touching the sort, and focus goes back to the header.
- A header that does not sort (`sortable: false`, a masked column) opens the same menu with Hide column alone; its click changes no sort, as before (L2 S1).
- Hide column chosen from the menu gives focus to the header beside the hidden one (the next, else the previous).
- The column menu is now a Radix `DropdownMenu` (non-modal, like the row context menu), wherever it opens: the header under the provider, a right-click on any header, and the design host's caret (#34794). Its entries are `role="menuitem"`. A press on the control it was opened from is that control's own toggle.
- The ↑1 / ↓2 header marks are unchanged.

**The header menu keeps a multi-level sort** (`ListView.handleHeaderSort`). The table still hands back the one column picked. With no sort or a single level, that column replaces the sort. With two levels or more it becomes the first level and every other level keeps its order after it; a column already in the sort moves up with the picked direction. No level is dropped. Persistence is unchanged (the same `onSortChange` as before, saved as the reader's own).

**A sort chip opens the sort panel** (`ConditionChipRow`, `ListView`). A click on a sort chip opens every level in one popover (the Sort panel's 「全部排序级别」 body, `sortPanelBody`: the reset-to-default row, the `SortBuilder`, the notes) and changes nothing; the chip no longer reverses its direction. The chip's × and its drag between chips are unchanged. `toggleSortOrder` (its only caller was the chip) is removed from the internal `conditionModel.ts`, and `ConditionChipRow`'s `renderSortLevels` is required, so a sort chip is never a button with no action.

**The sort builder reorders its levels** (`@object-ui/components` `SortBuilder`). The card asked to check the existing 「全部排序级别」 entry first: it opens the `SortBuilder`, which could not reorder levels, so the handle is added there. Each level row starts with a handle (`sortBuilder.reorder`, 「拖动以调整先后」): drag it onto another row, or press ArrowUp / ArrowDown on the focused handle (focus stays on the moved row's handle). The handle is a `span` with `role="button"` and a tab stop, not a `<button>`, because Firefox starts no HTML5 drag from a button (L2 S2; the repo's line-items grid handle is built the same way). A single level draws it `aria-disabled` and out of the tab order. The builder's drag events stop at the builder, so a host that draws it inside its own drag target (the sort chip) cannot undo the move (found in the browser, pinned in jsdom). Below `sm` the handle takes a column beside the level's three lines.

## For the phone cards (#35880, #35884)

The sort panel's content is `SortBuilder` from `@object-ui/components`: `fields` (value, label, optional `disabled` and `type`), `value: SortItem[]` and `onChange(next: SortItem[])`. It reads nothing from the list and writes nothing itself; every add, remove, direction change and reorder goes through `onChange`. So a phone bottom sheet can draw the same component and hold a staged copy for the 「点 ✓ 才生效」 layer, with no second save path. `ListView`'s `sortPanelBody` wraps it with the reset-to-default row and the notes for the desktop popover; that wrapper is ListView-internal and the phone container can reuse it or draw `SortBuilder` directly. The header-menu merge rule lives in `ListView.handleHeaderSort` (phones draw no column headers, per the card).

**Touch:** `SortBuilder` reorders by mouse drag (HTML5 drag and drop) and by ArrowUp / ArrowDown on the handle. Neither works on a touch screen, so #35884 needs a touch reorder affordance of its own (for example up / down buttons, or a touch drag), still writing through the same `onChange`.

## Why

#35876: on a two-level sort, a header click left a single level and stored it; a sort chip reversed its direction at once. The maintainer agreed the fix (「刷新去掉，其他同意」, then 「按这版立卡」), with 「已有多级时放到第一级」 rather than "replace and offer undo".

## Acceptance notes

- **Scope:** only grids `ListView` draws get the header menu. Related lists, dashboard tables, report tables and other `ObjectGrid` hosts keep click-to-sort (seat routing 16:39Z).
- **The column menu is a menu everywhere** it already opened (right-click, Studio's caret): same three entries, now with arrow-key navigation. Its outside-click close is Radix's (pointer down outside), no longer a document click listener.
- **Hide column** keeps today's meaning: it hides the column in this table until the next load; it is not stored.
- The `listConditions.chips.toggleSort` string is no longer read (the chip is named by its field and direction, `aria-haspopup="dialog"`); the key stays in the published locales, and only the internal fallback in `conditionTranslations.ts` is dropped.
- **Non-sortable columns:** 「点列头出菜单：升序、降序、隐藏这一列」 holds for every header. A header that does not sort (`sortable: false`, a masked column) opens the menu with Hide column alone, since a sort entry there would offer a sort the column refuses.
- A header that opens the menu is a tab stop and draws a `focus-visible` ring.
- Not in this PR: the toolbar layout and one merged sort chip (#35878), phone width (no headers; #35884), the footer calc row (#35702).
- Follow-up candidate, not filed: `docs/qa/platform-checklist` has no item that drives the header menu or the level reorder; `records-forms.adhoc-filter-sort-builder` covers the chips and builders but says nothing contrary, so no item is changed here.

## Tests

New:
- `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/complex/__tests__/data-table-header-menu-35876.test.tsx` — a header click opens the menu (three menu items) and changes no sort, a second click shuts it; the chosen entry is what the table hands its host; the multi-level marks stay; keyboard Enter → first item focused → ArrowDown → Enter sorts descending and focus returns; Esc shuts with no sort and focus returns; a non-sortable header opens a menu with Hide column alone, is a tab stop, and changes no sort; Hide column from the keyboard moves focus to the header beside it; CONTROL without the provider a click sorts and draws no menu.
- `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.headerMenuSort-35876.test.tsx` — ListView asks the grid for `headerMenu`; the card's four merge cases (two levels + new column → three, new first; two levels + an existing column descending → it moves first; no sort → that column; one level → replaced); a chip click opens the panel with every level and leaves the direction alone; ArrowUp on the second handle makes it the first level and the grid's sort and the chip priority follow; a mouse drag of the third handle onto the first row moves it there and the chip around the panel does not undo it.
- `ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/sort-builder-reorder-35876.test.tsx` — named handle per level, a draggable tab stop that is not a `<button>`; ArrowUp / ArrowDown; arrows past either end change nothing; drag onto a row; a drop with no drag of this list in flight is left to the host; a single level's handle is `aria-disabled` and out of the tab order.

Migrated (the behaviour they pinned is replaced by this card):
- `ListView.sortFieldFallback.test.tsx` › "restores the two-level default … after a header click flattened it" → "… after a header pick changed it": the pick now yields three levels, reset still restores the declared two. "CONTROL — the header click itself still replaces the whole sort array" → "CONTROL — a header pick over a two-level sort puts its column first and drops no level".
- `listConditions.test.tsx` › "… and flip on click" → "… and open the sort levels on click without flipping".
- `ListView.conditionRow-35549.test.tsx` › the Reset case made the sort differ by flipping the chip; it now removes the chip instead.
- `data-table-header-column-menu-34794.test.tsx` and `app-shell/…/DataPillar.recordsTab-34794.test.tsx`: the menu's entries are read as `menuitem`, not `button`.
- `list-builders-phone-width-29074.test.tsx`: the row's phone grid gains the handle column.
- `sort-builder-disabled-entry-11943.test.tsx`, `ListView.sortRemovableOnly-11943.test.tsx`, `ListView.sortPersistLeak.test.tsx`, `ListView.withheldFields-34901.test.tsx`: a builder row now holds two buttons, so its remove control is found by name.
- `clickableNonControlCensus-13461.test.ts`: the column menu's `div · stopPropagation` wrapper is gone (repaired), so its declared row is deleted.
- `ui/e2e/list-condition-row-35549.spec.ts` (Build & E2E UI) › the sort case: the chip is read as `sort-chip-open-amount`; "a header click shows as a chip" → "a header menu pick shows as a chip": a header click opens `column-context-menu` and leaves the sort empty, then Sort descending gives `amount:desc` and its chip. The same case now also opens a chip's panel and drags the second level's handle onto the first row with Playwright `dragTo` (a real pointer drag in Chromium).

Voided: none.

## Verification

- `vitest` (from `ui/`), base of the run `fc35f473` plus the migrations: `packages/components`, `packages/plugin-list`, `packages/plugin-grid` whole — 971 files, 9291 tests: 12 failed, all old pins listed under *Migrated*; after the migrations the 11 affected files re-run: 11 passed, 103 tests, 0 failed (plus `sort-builder-reorder-35876` after its host fix, 6/6). `packages/app-shell` whole: stopped after 53 minutes on the shared box without a summary → NOT MEASURED locally; CI's UI test job runs it. The app-shell file this PR migrated (`DataPillar.recordsTab-34794`) and `defaults-maps-mirror-en-pack` pass on their own.
- After the CI fix and the L1-b rework (`663cd467`): the 5 affected unit files 79/79 passed; `ui/e2e/list-condition-row-35549.spec.ts` under Playwright chromium (local config without the preview web server): 3/3 passed.
- `eslint` on every changed `.ts` / `.tsx` file: 0 errors (warnings only, pre-existing kinds).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 42 derived commands, run one by one on `c3e4d776`: 40 exit 0; the other two re-run on `663cd467`: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` exit 0 (172 files, 5111 tests passed, 2 skipped), `pnpm check:type-check-debt` exit 0.
- CI on `c3e4d776` failed Build & E2E UI, Type Check UI and Lint UI on one error: `DropdownMenuContent` does not type `onOpenAutoFocus` (TS2322 in the `@object-ui/components` declaration build). Fixed in `663cd467` (the first entry is focused from an effect). Locally on that tree: the `@object-ui` closure build (`turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/plugin-list^... --filter=@object-ui/plugin-grid^...`, which runs the components declaration build with fail-on-type-errors) exit 0; `pnpm run type-check` in `components`, `plugin-grid`, `plugin-list`, `i18n`: exit 0 each.
- CI on `663cd467`: every check green but `Test UI (16/16)`: `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/zh-hant-generated.test.ts` — `zh-Hant.ts` is generated from `zh-Hans.ts` and the hand-written `reorder` string differed from the converter's (拖曳 vs 拖動). Regenerated with `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n gen:zh-hant` in `046c89d3`; that file 11/11 and `packages/i18n` whole 1957 passed locally.
- L2 should-fixes S1 and S2 and its nit, in `7dcbb2e8`: `packages/components`, `packages/plugin-list` and `packages/plugin-grid` whole under the verify lock — 971 files passed (1 skipped), 9274 tests passed, 24 skipped, 0 failed. `ui/e2e/list-condition-row-35549.spec.ts` with the new handle drag step, Chromium: 3/3. Studio header tests (`StudioDesignSurface.leafColumnSelection-12725`, `DataPillar.recordsScroll-35061`, `DataPillar.recordsTab-34794`): 21/21. `type-check` in `components`: exit 0; eslint on the changed files: 0 errors.
- NOT MEASURED: the handle drag in Firefox and WebKit (the container has Chromium only). The handle is now a `span` like the line-items grid's handle; Chromium's real `dragTo` passes on it.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs`: VERDICT clean (merges cleanly with `origin/main` `8c18a362`; no open PR shares a file).
- Changed lines under the 3000 threshold (dispatch-gates: 859 at `457c7b3c`, before docs).
- **Browser, before / after** — `examples/app-showcase` (`objectstack dev --seed-admin`, own port and DB) with the `ui/apps/console` Vite dev server over it, headless Chromium 1400×900, zh-CN, the task list (`showcase_task`). Before = `main` `8c18a362`; after = this branch's `ui/` sources over the same server.
  - Before: with three levels (priority, status, due date), a click on the priority header left `priority desc` alone, and a reload kept it; a click on the sort chip flipped it to `asc` at once.
  - After, from no sort: Sort → status, Sort → due date (two levels). A click on the priority header opens the menu, levels unchanged; Esc closes, unchanged. Menu 升序排列 on priority → priority, status, due date. Menu 降序排列 on status → status desc, priority, due date (still three). Reload keeps it. A click on a sort chip opens the panel with three rows and three handles, nothing changes. ArrowUp on the second handle → priority first, the header marks follow, and a reload keeps it. A mouse drag (Playwright `dragTo`) of the third level onto the first moves it there and the marks follow. Keyboard: focus the progress header, Enter opens the menu, ArrowDown + Enter → progress desc first, the other three after it.
  - Not measured: Safari / WebKit (no WebKit build in the container); touch.
